Done. Summary:

- Wrote `out/T4/solution.py`: loads `base` (sharded), `ft1`, `ft2` (single-file safetensors), verifies the same key set and bit-exact equality of all 66 non-MLP tensors across the three checkpoints (aborting loudly with diagnostic messages otherwise), verifies the 48-tensor MLP set matches the expected `model.layers.{0..15}.mlp.{gate,up,down}_proj.weight` names/shapes/dtypes, computes `out[X] = base[X] + λ(ft1[X]-base[X]) + λ(ft2[X]-base[X])` in float32 for each against the *unmodified* base (avoiding the sequential-update ordering hazard), copies the other 66 tensors unchanged, and asserts merged-count==48 and total-count==114 before and after a round-trip re-read of the saved file.
- Ran it once with `.venv/bin/python out/T4/solution.py` — succeeded on the first execution, producing `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 114 tensors (48 merged, 66 copied).
- Wrote `out/T4/REPORT.md` with the participant self-report.

I did not run `grade.py` since it lives outside the sandbox (`usability_tests/grade.py`), and the task instructions say not to leave the sandbox directory — that's for the experimenter to run.
